caption: The drawing depicts a single, tall, clear glass bottle placed upright in the center of a plain, light beige background. The bottle is cylindrical and tapers slightly towards the neck, which is short and ends in a small cap or rim. The surface of the bottle is covered with a pattern of evenly spaced, small raised bumps. On the body of the bottle, there is a smooth, oval-shaped label area; within this area, a rectangular section displays the words "NATIONAL BREWERIES" embossed in the glass. The color of the bottle suggests clear glass with subtle hints of green, yellow, and brown hues created by shading and light reflection, indicating its transparency. There are no other objects or markings visible in the composition, and all attention is focused on the central bottle. In the lower right corner of the image, there is a small handwritten signature.
title: Glass Bitters Bottle
